remarks: Townhouse living at its finest! - Huge 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom in one of Norwalk's premier condo complexes! - Updated galley kitchen with stainless steel appliances + breakfast bar - Sun-soaked south-facing living/dining room with fireplace - Sliding door out to balcony to enjoy your morning coffee - Master bedroom with double closets + en-suite bath - Spiral staircase leads to oversized loft area for home office - 1-car attached garage + additional parking in lot - Laundry room + extra storage in basement area - Park-like setting with shared courtyard + walking path along the river - Situated right by Route 7 connector for easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and tons of shopping and dining - Excellent credit required, pets considered on a case-by-case basis
